name: DKG Notebook Memory
description: Export explicitly selected Jupyter notebook findings to private Working Memory. Stable cell provenance, content-addressed revisions, verified readback and repeat-safe writes let research agents retain hypotheses separately from observations without executing notebook code.

install.usageHint: Mark notebook cells metadata.dkg.export=true. Preview: dkg-notebook-memory plan research.ipynb --project EXISTING_GRAPH --source https://example.org/research --agent researcher. Replace plan with push to write; recall ASSET --project EXISTING_GRAPH to retrieve.

security.notes: HTTP literal loopback origins only; redirects rejected. Source URLs are provenance labels and are never fetched. No runtime dependencies or installation scripts. Explicitly selected source text only: no notebook execution, outputs or attachments. Selected text still requires operator review for secrets. Requires an existing Context Graph. No SHARE, PUBLISH or chain transactions. Concurrent same-asset writes must be serialized.

promotionPath: Selected findings start as private WM assertions. An authorized Curator may later finalize and SHARE them through the standard lifecycle; PUBLISH is a separate explicitly authorized operation. The integration fabricates no UAL: downstream promotion must retain the actual published UAL and provenance, and context oracles must independently assess source reliability and verification level.
fitNotes: Research agents can resume from selected hypotheses, observations and conclusions with stable cell identity and source provenance. Edits create new revisions; reordered cells and changed execution outputs do not. No native agent-framework plugin, external adoption or on-chain validation is claimed.
